final:
settings(keys: List[str], values: List[str]) -> List[str] =
  pre keys.len() == values.len()
  post out.len() >= 2
  post out.len() <= keys.len() + 2
  ex settings([], []) == ["fast", "3"]
  ex settings(["level"], ["5"]) == ["fast", "5"]
  ex settings(["color", "mode"], ["red", "slow"]) == ["slow", "3", "red"]
  var mode = "fast"
  var level = "3"
  var extra_keys: List[str] = []
  var extra_vals: List[str] = []
  for i in range(0, keys.len())
    let k = keys[i]
    let v = values[i]
    if k == "mode"
      mode = copy v
      continue
    if k == "level"
      level = copy v
      continue
    var found = False
    for j in range(0, extra_keys.len())
      if extra_keys[j] == k
        extra_vals[j] = copy v
        found = True
    if not found
      extra_keys.append(copy k)
      extra_vals.append(copy v)
  var out: List[str] = []
  out.append(mode)
  out.append(level)
  for v in extra_vals
    out.append(copy v)
  out
